self_controls.canonical: Exact R/Python selfnident and original-span statistic both equal summed container length. Original target references require this.
self_controls.ambiguous: Exact R/Python selfcounts agreement, finite integer nident>0 and<=summed length; original-span statistic finite positive integer. Do not force100% or bound span as union coverage.
self_controls.generic_helper: Retain original helper generic comparison, including its all-base self failures; separate dataset-specific selfcheck applies this already-frozen ambiguity rule.

numeric_agreement.generic_helper_failures: Preserve generic ambiguity failures; require separately declared dataset-specific self rule. No forced100% or universal equivalence claim.

GPL_external_boundary.adapter: Pinned external subprocess only, no in-package import or upstream edits. External driver retains GPL notice and calls existing adapter functions.

node_semantics: Old261source containers and2original references remain. Add3official genotype nodes with offset0 and exact public DNA; never merge by readable name. Preserve multirecord numeric offsets and every HSP literal/order as prior validated method.
seeds: Original target reference roles plus every direct-near-hit container key from the new273-record gp17 audit; broader keys report-only, not exclusion seeds.
official_panel_mapping: Map49exact official-author DNA matches to source:<ID>; map3mismatches to official:<ID>:<version>. Genotype correspondence only; no physical stock identity or label reassignment inferred.
old_vs_new_comparison: Retain old matrix unchanged. Compare projected old-node component memberships and official-node affiliations after validation; do not assume old numeric values stay identical when database context changes.
next_gate: No phenotype admission, split choice, model fitting or original case coverage. Derive final eligible panel only after both host and phage reference gates pass.
